selection_note: Cotter best-iterate selector picked epoch ~12 (10% task-loss slack pulled selection back to early task-optimal iterates); 200 epochs of constrained gradient descent drove mean R² from 0.169 (best.pt) -> 0.038 (final.pt). Linear-R² and post-hoc-MLP delta in this summary are computed from final.pt; task accuracies are from the training-time evaluation at best.pt and may differ slightly at final.pt.
